name: Hillsboro Favorites 2024
information: ## Please read the "What is a Favorites Competition?" tab before registering. ### The schedule is subject to change as we people register and we get final event counts This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HillsboroFavorites2024#43596-competitor-responsibilities) tab. **Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!** [![PNW Cubing Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2QzIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fcd77227d551876bfa5fba1188db32c98f6b91f6/pnw-logos_logo-main.png)]((https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085))
